title: Naturality of the local H₁-to-conormal comparison
statement: Let k,B,A be commutative rings, with B and A local [def-weil-regular-scheme], and a tower k→B→A in which B→A is local. Put K₀=κ(B), K=κ(A), and let P₀=(B→K₀) and P=(A→K) be the surjective extensions. Using the canonical surjection isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-jacobi-zariski-surjection-h1], define c₀:H₁(L_{K₀/k})→P₀.Cotangent and c:H₁(L_{K/k})→P.Cotangent. There exists a K-linear map μ:K⊗_{K₀}P₀.Cotangent→P.Cotangent satisfying μ(r⊗[x])=r[image(x)] for x∈ker(B→K₀) and μ∘(c₀⊗K)=c∘(H₁(L_{K₀/k})⊗K→H₁(L_{K/k})). Cotangent means the kernel modulo its square [def-weil-regular-scheme]; H₁ and its canonical maps use the polynomial presentations [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

proof.text: Build the morphism f between the residue surjection extensions using B→A and the induced residue-field map. Extension.Cotangent.map f is K₀-linear; liftBaseChange gives μ. Cotangent.map_mk and the pure-tensor formula for liftBaseChange prove the displayed generator identity.

proof.text: Reinterpret the two residue surjections as extensions Q₀,Q over k. Their cotangent modules and surjection isomorphisms are definitionally the same as those for P₀,P. h1CotangentEquivCotangent_comp_map expresses each c as the canonical presentation H₁ map followed by the kernel inclusion. Cotangent.map commutes with that inclusion.

proof.text: The composite presentation morphisms from k[K₀] to Q through Q₀ and through k[K] induce equal maps on H₁ by Extension.H1Cotangent.map_eq. map_comp_apply identifies their factorizations, proving the square on pure tensors. Tensor induction, additivity and K-linearity prove the entire square.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localCotangentComparison_naturality
    (k : Type u) (B : Type v) (A : Type w)
    [CommRing k] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra B A] [Algebra k A] [IsScalarTower k B A]
    [IsLocalRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B A)] :
    let K₀ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField B
    let K := IsLocalRing.ResidueField A
    let P₀ := Extension.ofSurjective (Algebra.ofId B K₀) IsLocalRing.residue_surjective
    let P := Extension.ofSurjective (Algebra.ofId A K) IsLocalRing.residue_surjective
    let c₀ := P₀.h1CotangentEquivCotangent.toLinearMap.comp (H1Cotangent.map k B K₀ K₀)
    let c := P.h1CotangentEquivCotangent.toLinearMap.comp (H1Cotangent.map k A K K)
    ∃ μ : K ⊗[K₀] P₀.Cotangent →ₗ[K] P.Cotangent,
      (∀ (r : K) (x : P₀.ker),
        μ (r ⊗ₜ[K₀] Extension.Cotangent.mk x) =
        r • Extension.Cotangent.mk (P := P) ⟨algebraMap B A x.val, by
          change IsLocalRing.residue A (algebraMap B A x.val) = 0
          rw [← IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_residue]
          have hx : IsLocalRing.residue B x.val = 0 := x.2
          rw [hx, map_zero]⟩) ∧
      μ.comp (c₀.baseChange K) =
        c.comp ((H1Cotangent.map k k K₀ K).liftBaseChange K)
